messages:
Dana: Heads-up — our playbook automation skipped ~1.2k accounts in the 'Onboarding in progress' bucket this morning. I exported a quick inventory here: https://docs.internal/redwood/cs/playbook-inventory (read-only). Can folks triage? :eyes:
Miguel: On it. Do we know why they were skipped? Any common signal?
Dana: Early look shows many are missing the segment tag (segment = null) so playbook predicates fail. Also a handful hit the rate-limit error from the webhook retries.
Priya: I can take the segment-less set. Quick query to pull them:
```
SELECT account_id, onboarding_status, segment
FROM cs_accounts
WHERE onboarding_status = 'in_progress' AND (segment IS NULL OR segment = '')
LIMIT 1000;
```
Priya: Will create a backfill job to add 'unknown' segment then run playbook against the backfilled cohort.
Helen: I'll investigate webhook retry errors. OnboardingBot posted two failing runs around 08:12 UTC.
OnboardingBot: playbook_run failed for run_id=run_2026-03-15-0812, code=429, detail="upstream webhook rate limit"
Miguel: For the segment backfill — let's not overwrite existing segment values. Add a flag so ops can review before we change >100 accounts.
Dana: Agreed. Priya, add a confirmation step for >100 updates. Also add a healthscore check: if healthscore < 30, hold the automation and ping CS lead.
Priya: Will implement: backfill label = 'segment:unknown', preview report to #cs-ops and require :thumbsup: to proceed.
Jake: If webhook is hitting 429, we can add exponential backoff and increase our worker concurrency cap temporarily. I'll open a short-lived job to throttle retries.
Helen: Found a noisy partner integration that spikes retries; tagging @partners to throttle during the sweep.
Dana: Plan for rollout: 1) run preview of backfill (safe, no updates), 2) review in #cs-ops, 3) apply backfill with confirmation, 4) rerun playbooks for affected accounts, 5) monitor healthscore drift and renewal risk alerts for 24h.
Miguel: Sounds good. ETA for preview?
Priya: Preview export ready in ~90m. Will post CSV + small dashboard of impacted cohorts.
Dana: Thanks — if anyone sees high-risk accounts in the preview (renewal < 90 days), flag them directly in the CSV so CSMs can add manual touches.
Helen: Noted. I'll monitor OnboardingBot and post follow-ups.
Miguel: I'll coordinate with Product if playbook predicates need a permanent change (e.g., treat missing segment as 'unknown' without blocking).
Dana: Great. Thanks all. I'll update the doc with the rollout checklist and timeline after Priya posts the preview. :white_check_mark:
